title: Medical Incident Report

nodes.text: For non-emergency, work through chain of command to report and transport injured personnel

evidence.source_text: FOR A NON-EMERGENCY INCIDENT, WORK THROUGH CHAIN OF COMMAND TO REPORT AND TRANSPORT INJURED PERSONNEL AS NECESSARY.

nodes.text: For medical emergency, identify on-scene incident commander and announce 'Medical Emergency'

evidence.source_text: FOR A MEDICAL EMERGENCY: IDENTIFY ON-SCENE INCIDENT COMMANDER BY NAME AND POSITION AND ANNOUNCE "MEDICAL EMERGENCY" TO INITIATE RESPONSE FROM IMT COMMUNICATIONS/DISPATCH.

nodes.text: Contact communications/dispatch and verify correct frequency

evidence.source_text: 1. CONTACT COMMUNICATIONS / DISPATCH (Verify correct frequency prior to starting report)

nodes.text: Provide incident status: summary, number of patients, command structure

evidence.source_text: 2. INCIDENT STATUS: Provide incident summary (including number of patients) and command structure.

nodes.text: Determine severity of emergency and transport priority
Describe nature of injury or illness and mechanism of injury

evidence.source_text: Nature of Injury or Illness and Mechanism of Injury

nodes.text: Request evacuation: Air Ambulance, Short-Haul/Hoist, Ground Ambulance, or Other
Provide patient location: descriptive location and Lat./Long.
Identify incident name and on-scene incident commander

evidence.source_text: 3. INITIAL PATIENT ASSESSMENT: Complete this section for each patient as applicable

nodes.text: Develop evacuation plan: location, helispot/extraction site size and hazards
Establish communications: State Air/Ground EMS Frequencies and Hospital Contacts
Consider contingency plans if primary options fail

evidence.source_text: REMEMBER: Confirm ETAs of resources ordered.
